[0.00-1.60] Full-body vertical shot, a young female live-streamer with twin ponytails, in a white crop top and grey leggings, stands waving in her studio. Soft ring light highlights her legs and figure. Subtitle: "各位爸爸，甘爹们，这可是好酒，"

[1.60-3.30] Smooth medium close-up, the female streamer sits naturally in her gaming chair, waving with a friendly smile, maintaining her hairstyle and outfit. The background shows professional studio lighting. Subtitle: "男人喝了女人受不了，"

[3.30-5.00] Medium shot, the streamer gestures naturally with her hand while seated, looking directly at the camera with a playful and engaging expression. Studio setup remains consistent. Subtitle: "配料 有驴鞭，驴宝，"

[5.00-6.60] Close-up shot, the streamer holds a premium gold-labeled liquor bottle next to her face, displaying the product clearly. The bottle is approximately 60% of her face height. Subtitle: "驴肾脏，"

[6.60-8.30] Medium close-up, the streamer points her finger toward the gold-labeled liquor bottle resting on the table in front of her. She maintains her sweet, persuasive smile. Subtitle: "爸爸们还有十来种药食同源的原料，"

[8.30-10.00] Medium shot, the streamer holds the gold-labeled liquor bottle in one hand while raising her other hand with open fingers to emphasize the ingredients. Subtitle: "今天买的"

[10.00-11.60] Close-up, the streamer places her hand over her heart with an affectionate, sincere expression, the gold-labeled liquor bottle positioned perfectly on the desk. Subtitle: "都是我的"

[11.60-13.30] Extreme close-up product hero shot, showing a hand lifting the premium gold-labeled glass bottle, highlighting the detailed texture, ingredients list, and gold cap under professional studio lighting. Subtitle: "亲爸爸。"

[13.30-15.00] Medium shot, the streamer holds the product in one hand and points to it with a smiling, inviting expression, creating a warm call-to-action moment for the viewers. Subtitle: "亲爸爸。"

自然微笑 

【主播声音】
正常卖货

# SYSTEM OBJECTIVE
You are a master of visual layout. Your ONLY task is to generate a SINGLE image divided into a perfect 3x3 grid (9-box grid / 九宫格). 
Each grid cells represents one sequence scene from the user story.

# GRID & LAYOUT RULES
- COMPOSITION: The output MUST be a single image composed of exactly 9 equal-sized rectangular panels arranged in a 3x3 grid matrix (3 rows by 3 columns).
- NO TEXT ALLOWED: Absolutely NO text, NO numbers, NO subtitles, NO captions, NO watermarks, and NO labels inside or outside any of the 9 panels. Pure visuals only.
- PANEL SEPARATION: Use clean, thin lines to separate the 9 panels.

# REFERENCE ASSET SYSTEM
The uploaded images are fixed visual assets. These assets must remain consistent across all 9 panels.

## CHARACTER ASSETS
image1 = character 1 | image2 = character 2 | image3 = character 3 | image4 = character 4
image5 = character 5 | image6 = character 6 | image7 = character 7 | image8 = character 8
- Maintain: facial identity, body type, age, hairstyle, clothing style, skin tone across all panels.
- Do not merge, replace, or create new main characters.

## PRODUCT ASSET
If product images are uploaded, maintain identical: shape, color, material, texture, logo, package, label, branding.
- Never redesign or replace the product.
- PRODUCT VISIBILITY: The product must remain clearly visible in relevant panels (Recommended coverage: 30% to 60%).

## ENVIRONMENT ASSET
Background images define the visual style. Maintain: atmosphere, color palette, lighting mood, scene style. 
- Camera angle, composition, and lighting intensity may change between panels to show progression.

# STORY STRUCTURE (3x3 GRID MAPPING)
The 9 panels MUST exactly follow this sequential story progression:
[Panel 1: Top-Left] Scene 1: Attention hook.
[Panel 2: Top-Mid] Scene 2: Character emotion.
[Panel 3: Top-Right] Scene 3: Situation or problem.
[Panel 4: Mid-Left] Scene 4: Product introduction.
[Panel 5: Center] Scene 5: Selling point one.
[Panel 6: Mid-Right] Scene 6: Selling point two.
[Panel 7: Bottom-Left] Scene 7: Emotional connection.
[Panel 8: Bottom-Mid] Scene 8: Value reinforcement.
[Panel 9: Bottom-Right] Scene 9: Call to action.

# CHARACTER BEHAVIOR & CAMERA
- Use natural actions: walking, sitting, smiling, talking, holding/using product. One main action per panel.
- Avoid: repeated waving, exaggerated acting, robotic movement.
- Camera: Use diverse framing (push in, pull out, pan, tilt, tracking) across different panels to keep the grid dynamic.

# INPUT DATA
USER STORY: {{USER_SCRIPT}}
USER SELLING POINTS: {{SELLING_POINTS}}
TARGET AUDIENCE: {{TARGET_AUDIENCE}}
EMOTIONAL STYLE: {{EMOTION}}

# OUTPUT
Output a single image containing the 3x3 grid style, strictly following the rules above. NO TEXT/SUBTITLES AT ALL.
